comments.author: @fredricknjugu93
comments.text: Funny how Japan and the East worships nature (God), under names of gods, Buddha etc. Look, I have been through all that, even once listening to Alan Watts (a once staunch Evangelist), and even through your videos, the only truth that exists and makes sense is that of God. Revealed Himself, and even time itself (the past : cavemen era, etc.) is aligned to that truth. Nothing else makes sense, and has a sense of relief : the truth that sets free.
